import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
grid=[[6]*12 for _ in range(6)]
grid[0][11]=grid[1][11]=1
grid[2][0]=grid[3][0]=1
grid[2][2]=7
# projected horizontal row from right boundary to left; marker line rightwards
out=[r[:] for r in grid]
out[0][1:11]=[7]*10
out[2][2]=4
out[2][3:11]=[7]*8
print(out)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Colored bars at opposite edges specify a transverse line; interior markers
    # project their offset onto the opposite bar and connect along that axis.
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    colors=[x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg]
    bar=colors[0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,bar)]
    if not pts: return g
    c=pts[0][1]  # marker color
    # locate solid edge bars of the framing color
    left=[i for i in range(h) if g[i][0]==bar]
    right=[i for i in range(h) if g[i][-1]==bar]
    if left and right:
        top=min(right); lo=min(left)
        for j in range(1,w-1): g[top][j]=c
        for i,j in pts:
            g[i][j]=4
            for x in range(j+1,w-1): g[i][x]=c
    else:
        return g
    return g
'''
